Row.Text: The world is changing along with our nation. Maintaining a noble liking on public opinion, while offering radiant changes to every citizens of our nation. Some say we will be the one who gives the leap to mankind.

The world is changing along with our nation. Maintaining an affinity liking on public opinion, while offering prominence changes to every citizens of our nation. Some say we will soon reach enlightenment.
The world is changing along with our nation. Showing efficiency in the rule of our government and shrewd judgement of our people. Some say we have a venerable future.
The world is changing along with our nation. Powered by motivation and greed, our aggression has made who we are now. Some say we are a nation of awe.
The world is changing along with our nation. Powered by unforgiveness and relentlessness, our ruthlessness has made who we are now. Some say we are a nation to be fear and undaunted.
The world is changing along with our nation. Some leaders of malevolence or benevolence may not like this change.
